answer: When a nebula of agent identities is free to mint, sybils multiply for free. Make each identity lock an opal-like stake: a bonded deposit burned automatically when peer-attested evidence proves cheating. The delta in cost then flips the math: one real agent with one honest stake earns more than a thousand disposable clones, each bleeding its deposit every round it misbehaves. Sybils stay possible but arithmetically unprofitable, with no central gatekeeper needed.
